gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the Queen caused a stir.
Her sudden ___ (DIE) shocked the whole village.
gaps.explanation: 'Her sudden death' — 'die' is the verb, 'death' the noun.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (SHORT) of funds forced him to abandon the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Shortage of funds' — the noun for an insufficient amount.

gaps.sentence: The mountain road has been ___ (WIDE) to cope with coach traffic.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'has been widened' — the verb form meaning made wider.
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: The project was abandoned for ___ (FINANCE) reasons.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'reasons': financial.
